treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Norway and the Hungarian People's Republic for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1980)
eif_quote: Lovdata: Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 20-09-1981 | Art. 28: 2. The Convention shall enter into force sixty days after the exchange of diplomatic notes testifying the approval or ratification of the Convention. 3. The provisions of this Convention shall apply: a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, to amounts of income derived on or after 1. January in the calendar year next following the year in which the Convention enters into force;
source_title: St.prp. nr. 142 (1980-81), Vedlegg: Convention Norway-Hungary 1980 (English authentic text + Norwegian translation) in Stortingsforhandlinger 1980/81 vol. 2b, digitised by the National Library of Norway (Lovdata carries metadata only)

rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends, is a resident, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT in treaty; MLI not applicable to this pair)

notes: Single 10% dividend cap, no ownership tiers. Norwegian note of 1998-05-14 under the protocol (switch to credit method, in force 1999-08-26, effective 1999-01-01) does not affect Arts. 10-12. Text obtained from the official parliamentary bill (OCR of National Library scan); Lovdata has metadata only. Not MLI-covered: Hungary lists Norway but Norway does not list Hungary.
unverified: Text read from OCR of the scanned parliamentary bill, not a born-digital official file
